TOM MCCALL GOVERNOR
OFFICE OF THE GOVERNON STATE CAPITOL SALEM 97310
August 16, 1972
Mr. G. Douglas Hofe, Jr., Director United States Department of the Interior Bureau of Outdoor Recreation Washington, D.C. 20240
Re: Federal #K14
Off-Road Vehicles Draft EIS
PNRS #7207 4 040
Dear Mr. Hofe:
Review of the Draft Environmental Impact Statement is complete. Enclosed are comments from state agencies which we hope will help you to further evaluate your project.
Also enclosed is a comment from the Law Enforcement Council which does not have direct bearing on environmental alternatives but is significant in a programmatic sense. To further explore this area, we have forwarded a copy of the Off-Road Vehicles statement to Captain Walter Hershey of the Oregon State Police. Should he have any comments they will be sent directly to you.
You may use this letter as evidence of your compliance with Section 102(2)(C) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969 (83 Stat. 853), and OMB A-95 (Revised).
Sincerely
Kessler R. Cannon Assistant to the Governor
Natural Resources
